# Hello World!

**A beginner's guide to creating your first Git repository**

## Description

This repository demonstrates the basic steps to create a Git repository and add a README file. Perfect for developers just getting started with version control.

## Prerequisites

Before you begin, ensure you have:
- Git installed on your system ([Installation Guide](https://git-scm.com/downloads))
- Basic familiarity with the command line
- A terminal application

## Table of Contents

- [Quick Start](#quick-start)
- [Detailed Instructions](#detailed-instructions)

## Quick Start

Run these commands in your terminal:

```bash
mkdir ~/Hello-World
cd ~/Hello-World
git init
touch README
```

## Command Breakdown

- **mkdir ~/Hello-World** - Creates a directory for your project
- **cd ~/Hello-World** - Changes to the newly created directory
- **git init** - Sets up the necessary Git files
- **touch README** - Creates an empty README file
